_comment: Shown in the update prompts. Edit before each release. minVersion: apps older than this must update before they continue (use for security fixes); leave it at an old version normally.
notes: New professional icons across the whole app (Phosphor): solid icons in coloured tiles
Smoother, more premium feel: press feedback, ripples, springy switches and lifting cards
Lists and tiles slide in gently when a page opens
Desktop: cleaner header and wider dashboards
New club page look: dark photo cover, round logo, team photo cards and event cards
Club Team tab: executive team, members, committees; new Resources tab
